nodes.label: Private Production Ports
nodes.rationale: The production overlay binds Nginx only to loopback because TLS is terminated by an external reverse proxy and application and database ports remain private.

nodes.label: Membership-Derived Tenant Scope
nodes.rationale: Business requests must derive organization scope from authenticated membership rather than accepting organizationId in the request body.

nodes.label: Minimal Foundation Scope
nodes.rationale: Generic repositories, base services, universal response wrappers, Redis, queues, microservices, and empty domain folders are deferred until a real feature requires them.

nodes.label: Minimal Domain Rules
nodes.rationale: Use direct functions and the standard library before adding abstractions or dependencies, while retaining validation, tenant scoping, atomicity, and critical-behavior tests.

nodes.label: Single deployment migration job
nodes.rationale: API replicas must not each execute migrations; run one job before applications use the new schema.

nodes.label: Forward-fix migration policy
nodes.rationale: Shared migrations are not modified; production recovery prioritizes a forward fix and tested backup.

nodes.label: Environment credential isolation
nodes.rationale: Each dev and production environment needs distinct passwords, databases, and env files; combining overrides can expose the local PostgreSQL port.

nodes.label: Measured infrastructure expansion
nodes.rationale: Storage, Redis, queues, metrics, replicas, and DB-host separation are deferred until a measured need exists.

nodes.label: Initialization verification boundaries
nodes.rationale: Readiness must fail without the database, tenant queries require scope, and restore must not target the working database.

nodes.label: GET /ready
nodes.rationale: A successful database ping establishes connectivity only and does not verify migration version.

nodes.label: Tenant organization scope
nodes.rationale: Every tenant-data operation must scope organization_id from verified identity rather than client-provided scope.

nodes.label: Production customer-data readiness
nodes.rationale: The scaffold is not declared ready to store production customer data.

nodes.label: CI evidence boundary
nodes.rationale: Local results are not proof of remote CI until the repository workflow runs on its destination.
